entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker who collected stories on scrolls as catalysts for her magic; later compleated and led the New Phyrexian Invasion on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: Tamiyo's son, who took possession of her scrolls after her death.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A great wizard in Tamiyo's story who created Karn.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother and rival, whose armies were afflicted by black oil.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Heir created by Urza from pure metal.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Karn's successor, who longed to create and let black oil drown the garden.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi titan who warped one of the scrolls to allow her to be sealed in Innistrad's moon.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker referenced as the protector in white in the story's ending.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Discovered Tamiyo's journal after Jenrik's death.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane whose corruption is told in one of the iron-bound scrolls.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion of Kamigawa led by compleated Tamiyo.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane invaded by New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Tamiyo's Notebook
entities.description: A legendary Kamigawan tablet containing Tamiyo's writings, used after her compleation.

events.summary: After Tamiyo's death, her son Nashi takes possession of her scrolls.
events.quote: After her death, her son Nashi took possession of the scrolls, carrying on her legacy.

events.summary: Emrakul warps one of the iron-bound scrolls to allow herself to be sealed in Innistrad's moon.
events.quote: One of these stories was later warped by Emrakul to allow her to be sealed in Innistrad's Moon.

events.summary: Compleated Tamiyo, leading the invasion on Kamigawa, corrupts a bound scroll into the story of New Phyrexia.
events.quote: Tamiyo corrupted one of the bound scrolls into the following story:

events.summary: Before her compleation, Tamiyo stores all of her memories within a scroll to be animated after her death.
events.quote: Tamiyo stored all of her memories within a scroll, to be animated after her death.

events.summary: Tamiyo passes her journal to Jenrik; after his death Jace finds it.
events.quote: She passed the journal on to Jenrik, after whose death it was discovered by Jace Beleren.

relations.quote: her son Nashi took possession of the scrolls

relations.note: In the story, Urza creates Karn.
relations.quote: The wizard Urza creates an heir from pure, unvarnished metal.

relations.note: In the story, Karn appoints Memnarch as successor.
relations.quote: he appoints his own successor, Memnarch, to oversee it
